originalTitle: An Examination of A Matter of Public Interest by Azmat Ali
overview: An elite family from Karachi spirals into a public scandal, when the woman shares a video on social media accusing her ex-husband of sexually abusing their two daughters, turning a private family dispute into a matter of public outrage. As the father loses his reputation and the children struggle to make sense of their fractured childhood, Azmat Ali moves his documentary crew between both households in search of the truth.
tagline: My attempt to document the truth, whatever it may be.
title: An Examination of A Matter of Public Interest by Azmat Ali
